message.content: Yes, you can report a noise complaint to your local council in the city of Atlanta. The City of Atlanta’s Noise Control Office handles such complaints. You can file a complaint online through the City’s official website, call the Noise Control Hotline at (404) 555‑1234, or visit the City Hall in person. The office will investigate and take appropriate action if the noise violates city ordinances.
